# LivingDex.app

> A fast, modern, privacy-first Living Pokédex tracker for all main-series Pokémon games, including regional forms, DLC expansions, and shiny checklists.

## Documentation

- [LivingDex Home](https://livingdex.app/): Main application interface and living Pokédex tracker.
- [Pokémon HOME Tracker](https://livingdex.app/?game=home): Track the full National Pokédex (#1 to #1025).
- [Pokémon Scarlet & Violet Tracker](https://livingdex.app/?game=sv): Track Paldea Pokédex, The Teal Mask, and The Indigo Disk DLC expansions.
- [Pokémon Sword & Shield Tracker](https://livingdex.app/?game=swsh): Track Galar Pokédex, The Isle of Armor, and The Crown Tundra DLC expansions.
- [Pokémon Legends: Arceus Tracker](https://livingdex.app/?game=pla): Track Hisui Pokédex.
- [Pokémon Legends: Z-A Tracker](https://livingdex.app/?game=za): Track Lumiose City Pokédex.
- [Pokémon Brilliant Diamond & Shining Pearl Tracker](https://livingdex.app/?game=bdsp): Track Sinnoh Pokédex.
- [Pokémon Let's Go Pikachu & Eevee Tracker](https://livingdex.app/?game=lgpe): Track Let's Go Kanto Pokédex.
- [Pokémon Ultra Sun & Ultra Moon Tracker](https://livingdex.app/?game=usum): Track Updated Alola Pokédex.
- [Pokémon Sun & Moon Tracker](https://livingdex.app/?game=sm): Track Alola Pokédex.
- [Pokémon Omega Ruby & Alpha Sapphire Tracker](https://livingdex.app/?game=oras): Track Updated Hoenn Pokédex.
- [Pokémon X & Y Tracker](https://livingdex.app/?game=xy): Track Kalos Pokédexes (Central, Coastal, Mountain).
- [Pokémon Black 2 & White 2 Tracker](https://livingdex.app/?game=b2w2): Track Updated Unova Pokédex.
- [Pokémon Black & White Tracker](https://livingdex.app/?game=bw): Track Unova Pokédex.
- [Pokémon HeartGold & SoulSilver Tracker](https://livingdex.app/?game=hgss): Track Updated Johto Pokédex.
- [Pokémon Diamond, Pearl & Platinum Tracker](https://livingdex.app/?game=dppt): Track Sinnoh and Extended Sinnoh Pokédex.
- [Pokémon FireRed & LeafGreen Tracker](https://livingdex.app/?game=frlg): Track Kanto Pokédex.
- [Pokémon Ruby, Sapphire & Emerald Tracker](https://livingdex.app/?game=rse): Track Hoenn Pokédex.
- [Pokémon Gold, Silver & Crystal Tracker](https://livingdex.app/?game=gsc): Track Johto Pokédex.
- [Pokémon Red, Blue & Yellow Tracker](https://livingdex.app/?game=rby): Track original Generation 1 Kanto Pokédex.
- [Source Code](https://github.com/PimBARF/LivingDex): Official open-source GitHub repository.
- [Issues & Bug Reports](https://github.com/PimBARF/LivingDex/issues): Issue tracker and feature requests.

## Optional

- [Web App Manifest](https://livingdex.app/manifest.json): Progressive Web App manifest configuration.
- [Sitemap](https://livingdex.app/sitemap.xml): XML sitemap for search engine crawlers.
- [Donation & Support](https://ko-fi.com/pimbarf): Support project maintenance on Ko-fi.
